name: HippoBridge (FHIR HIS)
description: Worklist and prior reports from the Hipocrate HIS over HippoBridge's FHIR interface: start a report from a recent CT/MR exam, or — in a report's HippoBridge tab — find its patient, bring their other exams' reports into the wiki and fill what the report is missing.

url.label: HippoBridge address
url.help: the server's base address; /fhir/… is appended

username.label: Hipocrate user
username.help: one service account; HippoBridge forwards it to Hipocrate on every request

site.label: Site code
site.help: the site (Admin → Sites) of reports made from HIS data; empty = the first site

worklist_modalities.label: Worklist modalities
worklist_modalities.help: HIS modality codes: ct, irm, eco, radio

prior_types.label: Prior exam types
prior_types.help: which of the patient's HIS exams are offered as priors
